findings.title: [P1] Register proof-listed external configs with Vite's watcher
findings.body: Adding the proof paths to this private set only helps after an update hook is invoked. Vite's dev watcher watches the project root (plus files explicitly registered by plugins/config loading), so an extended config outside the rootâ€”such as the `../base.json` case added hereâ€”is not guaranteed to produce either `hotUpdate` or `handleHotUpdate` at all during a persistent-only startup. The new tests call the hooks directly and therefore miss this runtime path. When consuming the proof, register each config with the plugin context (for example via `this.addWatchFile(fileName)`); otherwise edits to the external config can leave the warm cached transform stale indefinitely.

overall_explanation: The in-hook invalidation logic handles proof-listed paths once Vite reports an update, but it does not ensure that external proof-listed configs are watched. Consequently, the explicit external-extended-config scenario can still fail in an actual dev server despite passing the direct hook tests.
